cards.text: It's still the night of the Last Supper, and Jesus is still teaching His disciples. He's just told them, "Love one another." (John 15:17) Now He turns to something harder: how the world will treat them.

cards.question: Jesus says the world may hate His disciples. Who does He say the world hated first?

cards.text: Jesus says He has chosen His disciples out of the world, so they are not of the world. Me? I got chosen out of a closing bakery's clearance bin with a sticker on me that said TWENTY-FIVE CENTS.

cards.question: If the disciples were of the world, Jesus says, the world would ___ them as its own.

cards.text: Then Jesus reminds them of a word He spoke before: "No servant is greater than his master." Friend, that's the new hire on Monday morning moving into a corner office BIGGER than the boss's, and that is NOT how it works.

cards.question: If people persecuted Jesus, the master, what does He say they'll do to His disciples?
Jesus also says that if people kept His word, they will keep His disciples' word as well.

cards.text: Then Jesus says they'll get treated this way because of His name. It's like wearing the other team's jersey to the home game: you WILL hear about it.

cards.question: People will persecute the disciples because of Jesus' name. What does Jesus say these people do not know?

cards.text: Then Jesus gets serious. If He had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin.

cards.question: Now that Jesus has come and spoken to the people who hate Him, those people still have an excuse for their sin.
Jesus says that whoever hates Him hates someone else as well. Who?

cards.text: And it's not only His words: Jesus did works among them that no one else did. Back when my edges wore down, the only thing I did that no one else did was stamp cookies SO blurry they looked like thumbprints.

cards.question: Jesus says the people who hate Him never saw the works He did among them.

cards.text: Jesus says even this fulfills what is written in their Law, a line He quotes from the Psalms (Psalm 35:19; 69:4) about how they hated Him.

cards.question: Jesus says the world's hatred fulfills a line written in their Law. That line says they hated Him for a good reason.

cards.text: Okay, friend, breathe. HERE comes the hope: Jesus says He will send them the Advocate from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father.

cards.question: What does Jesus say the Advocate will do when He comes?

answers.text: Take them out of the world

cards.question: Jesus says His disciples must testify about Him too, because they have been with Him from the beginning.

cards.text: Then Jesus stops and tells them why He's saying all this. Friend, when somebody pauses to explain WHY they're telling you something, you put the phone DOWN.

cards.question: Why does Jesus say He has told His disciples all these things?

answers.text: So they will not fall away
So they will hide from the world

cards.text: Then Jesus gets specific: they will put the disciples out of the synagogues. I got slid into the back of a junk drawer once and gave up on myself for a while, and friend, this is WAY bigger than a drawer.

cards.question: It goes further. Jesus says a time is coming when someone who kills His disciples will think he's doing what?

cards.text: They'll do these things, Jesus says, because they have not known the Father or Him. And He's telling the disciples so that when their hour comes, they'll remember He told them.

cards.question: Jesus says He told His disciples these things from the beginning.

cards.text: Jesus says He didn't tell them these things from the beginning, because He was with them. And that's where we pause, friend, because Jesus is NOT done talking to His disciples tonight.
